title: Postoperative determination of calprotectin in drains as an early biomarker for infections or anastomotic insufficiency after rectal resection
summary: Beeinflusst eine elektive Rektumresektion die Calprotectin-Spiegel im Serum und in der Drainage, und lassen sich diese Werte – allein oder in Kombination mit CRP, PCT, Leukozyten, Lactat und Zellzahl/pH in der Drainage – als frühzeitige Marker für postoperative Infektionen bzw. Anastomoseninsuffizienzen nutzen?

interventions.name: Elective rectal resection for carcinoma or a benign disease

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Age ≥ 18 years, planned elective rectal resection, placement of a postoperative drain near the anastomosis or surgical site (standardized procedure), written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Emergency surgeries, pre-existing chronic inflammatory bowel disease (e.g. Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis), systemic, chronic inflammatory or autoimmune diseases (e.g. rheumatoid arthritis, active infectious diseases)
